يستعذون (form X)
# يَسْتَعْذُونَ (yastaʕḏūna) /jas.taʕ.ðuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
# يُسْتَعْذَوْنَ (yustaʕḏawna) /jus.taʕ.ðaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْذَى (istaʕḏā)
